nodes.rationale: Repeated community-related term with and without hashtag syntax; little other evidence.
Season, temperature and morning observations vary across masks; related meaning without identical wording.
Well-wishes vary in weekend day, audience and religious qualification.
Detailed negative audiobook comments coexist with a broad Literature mask.
Related anxiety/stress terms with advice in just one instance.
A person/baby/family mask and a general family exhortation.

unchanged: Exact registered v3; same wrapper/executable/model/effort and numbered fragments as prior runs. No prompt edit or baseline re-run.
selection: Six complete additional multi-note nodes from the same HDBv2 artifact, selected from masks before generation. These are new nodes, not an unseen-corpus holdout; source notes may recur across earlier nodes. Preserve membership, duplicates and order.
evaluation: Judge semantic fit and justified specificity from every supplied mask. Accept unexpected but valid descriptions; no exact target titles. Separate output defects from limitations of masks/groupings. Assistant assessments are not user verdicts.
execution: One fresh isolated call per node; all raw outputs retained. No retries or output selection; no source notes, prior titles or review instructions in model input.
limitation: A small purposive sample, not a representative accuracy estimate. No automatic freeze or extra tests.
